summary: Tested the Gestione Società rename and the Enti e Federazioni feature end to end, on both the backend and the frontend. Backend: new suite test_asd_enti_rename.py (10 tests) plus the regression suite test_asd_anagrafica_unica.py (21 tests). After updating the old free-text 'ente' payloads to ente_id, all 31 pass with -n 0. Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): rename text, the searchable Ente dropdown, quick-add form, Settings group, disabled-ente behaviour, Marketplace card/detail and inactive-org hiding all work. No critical bugs found; 2 minor issues.

minor.issue: tesseramento.ente returns the stored label snapshot (t.ente), not the current label. After renaming an ente, the person section (person-asd-tess) still shows the old name, while GET /api/asd/tesseramenti ente_nome is correct. Reproduced: renamed TEST_UIF to TEST_UIR and persona_link still returned 'TEST_UIF – TEST Federazione UI'. Fix: resolve the label via ente_id from enti(org), as list_tess does.

The whole list is read, changed in Python and saved back with $set. Two admins saving at the same moment can overwrite each other's changes (last write wins). The duplicate check also has a race. Low risk but worth noting. A positional $push/$set update or a version check would avoid it.

ui_bugs.issue: Every EnteSelect mount calls GET /asd/enti again. While it loads, an edit dialog briefly shows the placeholder 'Cerca per sigla o denominazione…' instead of the saved ente. The label appears about 1s later. Cosmetic only; saving works.

issues: Data emissione/Data scadenza use the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar. This is an existing pattern in the app.
The delete confirmation text uses r.ente (snapshot) rather than r.ente_nome, so after a rename it can show a stale label.

action_items: persona_link (asd.py ~line 644): return the current ente label (via ente_id) instead of the t.ente snapshot
Optional: use r.ente_nome in the AsdTesseramenti delete confirm message
Optional: share the enti fetch (context/cache) so the edit dialog does not flash the placeholder
Optional: make enti list updates atomic to avoid lost updates under concurrent edits
critical_code_review_comments: enti() lazy init depends on _org_settings creating the settings doc; save_enti uses update_one without upsert. This works today because _org_settings inserts the doc first.

POST /api/asd/enti is allowed for any module member (org_role user too), while edit/toggle/order/delete require admin_org/superadmin. This looks intentional for the quick-add from tesseramenti; please confirm it matches the product rules.

Rename migration verified: marketplace_services name='Gestione Società', price 99 yearly, stripe_prices.test unchanged; schema_meta rename_gestione_societa_v1 holds a backup of the old name; 0 purchases with the old service_name.
